newsitem.title: USA: Lucent, GTE, Bell Atlantic, AT&T win big Navy contract.
newsitem.headline: Lucent, GTE, Bell Atlantic, AT&T win big Navy contract.

text.p: The Navy said Tuesday it had awarded a $2.934 billion contract to Lucent Technologies Inc., GTE Government Systems Corp., Bell Atlantic Federal Integrated Systems Inc. and AT&T Government Markets.
The contract is for voice, video and data modernisation of Navy telecommunications.
The contract is expected to be completed by July 2007.

The contract was announced after markets closed. AT&T stock closed up 56 cents at $36.94, while Bell Atlantic finished the day at $71.875, up 31 cents, both in composite trading on the New York Stock Exchange. Lucent rose 62.5 cents to $83.44 and GTE slipped 6 cents to $46.50, also on the NYSE.
